definitions.explanation: A new edition of a book in which additional content has been added to the original text — for example extra chapters, updated data, new illustrations, or a supplementary appendix. Distinct from a mere reprint, and usually advertised on the cover as evidence that the book has grown since its first publication.

examples.japanese: {増補版|ぞうほばん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: An expanded edition has come out.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{増補版|ぞうほばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought the expanded edition of this dictionary.

examples.japanese: {増補版|ぞうほばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{章|しょう}→章：03768_shou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦{追加|ついか}→追加：04060_tsuika⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The expanded edition has three new chapters added to it.

notes:
Compound of {増補|ぞうほ} ('adding to and supplementing') and ⟦{版|はん}→版：03698_han⟧ ('edition'). Used specifically when a later edition of a book includes material that was not in the original — extra chapters, new data, updated references, or bonus content — rather than when it simply fixes errors.

USAGE:
- Typically appears on book covers and in publisher catalogs, often as part of longer titles like {増補改訂版|ぞうほかいていばん} ('expanded and revised edition').
- Used for reference works, textbooks, essay collections, and scholarly monographs where content is added over time.
- Not used for simple reprints or editions that only correct typos.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {増補版|ぞうほばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to release an expanded edition
- {増補版|ぞうほばん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: an expanded edition is published
- {増補改訂版|ぞうほかいていばん}: expanded and revised edition
- ⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧な{増補版|ぞうほばん}: a substantially expanded edition
- {新|しん}{増補版|ぞうほばん}: newly expanded edition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{改訂版|かいていばん}→改訂版：17716_kaiteiban⟧: revised edition — revisions focus on correcting and updating existing content, not necessarily adding new material.
- ⟦{新版|しんぱん}→新版：22067_shinpan⟧: new edition — a general term for any later edition, without specifying whether content was added or revised.
- ⟦{初版|しょはん}→初版：15827_shohan⟧: first edition — the original printing, contrasted with an expanded edition.
- {復刻版|ふっこくばん}: reprint edition; facsimile edition — reproduces an older edition as-is, without adding new material.
- {文庫版|ぶんこばん}: pocket-book edition — refers to format rather than content changes.
